### Yukiro { #awakening-yukiro }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/yuki/yukiro.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Spreads snow around the user and raises a wall of hard snow at the edge that only the user can walk through Letting go early makes a smaller ring, and the cold inside keeps building until it turns to ice. Hard snow burns easily so a torch is a way out
